verdict.rationale: First-party Chat Connectors explicitly let users connect external AI apps such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and Le Chat to a Capacities space. This is backed by documented Model Context Protocol integration and a REST API with an OpenAPI spec for custom agents and tools. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the connectors work as described, and deeper documentation detail on connector setup and scope (the evidence has only a one-line description).
